architecture: facebook/esmfold_v1 via transformers.EsmForProteinFolding: ESM2-650M language-model backbone (fp16 on GPU) feeding a folding trunk (fp32) that outputs atom37 coordinates and pLDDT
plddt_scale: 0-1 fraction (not 0-100); mean_plddt ~0.69 on the reference defensin-like peptide
weights: full facebook/esmfold_v1 snapshot (~7.9GB) in model_store/model_weights/esmfold_v1/weights, vendored unmodified via huggingface_hub.snapshot_download
metrics: none; third-party pretrained model with no platform-side evaluation
